fields.description: Albero offers one to three bedroom apartments and three bedroom townhouses in the Green Gate neighbourhood of Dubai Creek Harbour. Balconies, landscaped arrival spaces and townhouse roof terraces connect the homes to their surroundings. The residential facilities combine an infinity pool, fitness spaces and areas for play and outdoor gatherings.

overview: Albero’s brochure distinguishes its residential pool, yoga, garden and gathering spaces from the wider Green Gate neighbourhood. Community plans include sports courts, running and cycling routes, a skate park and a climbing wall. Inside, earthy colours, generous glazing and kitchens with planned appliances support the quieter residential setting. Facility delivery and final appliance specifications should be checked for the chosen release.
research.locationNote: Albero sits in Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour. The developer’s map identifies Creek Beach, the promenade, Central Park and Creek Marina within the wider community. Connections to Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport are road journeys; promotional travel times and future transport proposals are not guarantees.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s page displays pricing from AED 1,813,888 on the research date. The published selection is not a reservation or confirmation of stock; obtain a current price for the selected residence.
research.paymentNote: The reviewed launch schedule is 10% at booking, seven 10% instalments and 20% at completion. Property Finder also lists a 10/90 alternative, but no corresponding dated developer document was established. Confirm which agreement applies; the historical schedule below is not a new offer.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document targets September 2029 for estimated construction completion, corroborated by Property Finder. Current progress and the contractual handover date require confirmation.

facts.label: Launch composition
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 479 homes: 211 one bedroom, 210 two bedroom and 52 three bedroom apartments, plus six three bedroom townhouses. These figures describe the launch, not remaining availability.

facts.label: Historical type prices
facts.value: Launch prices started at AED 1.81 million, AED 2.71 million and AED 4.11 million for one, two and three bedroom apartments respectively; townhouses started at AED 6.95 million.

facts.label: Tower arrangement
facts.value: The official plan pack labels the tower B+G+3P+53. Some apartment areas change by level, so bedroom count alone does not establish the precise size.

facts.label: Townhouse outdoor space
facts.value: The three-level townhouse drawings include roof terraces and a maid’s room. Internal suites measure 2,439.32–2,443.84 sq ft; the larger published totals include 1,641.17–1,722.01 sq ft of balcony/terrace area.

unresolved: The launch sheet lists maxima of 776 sq ft for one bedroom and 1,455 sq ft for two; reviewed official layout pages establish smaller maxima. Additional podium/layout sheets would be needed to extend these ranges.
